from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u087/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_text='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [[0] * (w * w) for _ in range(h * h)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color:
                for tr in range(h):
                    for tc in range(w):
                        if grid[tr][tc] == 0:
                            out[r * h + tr][c * w + tc] = color
    return out
'''
